text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "Sold out at this bookstore too...? But this is already the fifth one...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like that manga gets more popular
every time a new volume comes out..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What should I do... It's almost time for
training, but still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"It's about 2.2 km to the bookstore near the next station...
If I sprint on the dedicated running lane, it'll take just over two minutes...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Make sure you're selling it next time!

In the end, the manga she was looking for wasn't found,
and even when training time arrived,
Mejiro Dober continued searching for it.
